ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 26 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly aligned. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 6 · daily cycle day 26).
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 26 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 26 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 6 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: early — lots of room left in the bigger up-leg
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 6 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 早期——更大的上行段仍有充足空间
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 26 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线一致。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 6 周 · 日线周期第 26 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 10 trading days ago (~2026-06-11), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score +45/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 10 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+28）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
